business_summary: CNPC Capital Company Limited provides financial services in China and internationally. It provides savings deposits, personal loans, bank cards, investment and wealth management, and credit cards; deposit settlement, traditional financing, investment banking, supply chain financing, and corporate credit; and international settlement, international trade finance, and foreign exchange business. The company also offers payment and collection, internal transfer settlement, bill acceptance and discounting; financial leasing, operating leasing and sale-leaseback; and asset servicing trust, asset management trust, and charitable trust. In addition, it provides property loss insurance, liability insurance, credit insurance, guarantee insurance, short-term health insurance, accident insurance, and reinsurance services, as well as life and investment-linked insurances, and group employee benefit plans. Further, the company engages in insurance brokerage, insurance loss assessment, and risk consulting; provision of risk reduction, claims investigation and inspection, loss assessment and settlement, residual value processing, marine claims settlement, and claims consulting; and corporate credit enhancement, credit product creation and trading, and asset investment. Additionally, it offers securities brokerage; securities investment consulting; financial advisory services related to securities trading and investment activities; securities underwriting and sponsorship; proprietary securities trading; securities asset management; margin trading; distribution of mutual funds and financial products; and management of publicly offered mutual funds, as well as services to futures companies. The company was formerly known as Jinan Diesel Engine Co., Ltd. and changed its name to CNPC Capital Company Limited in February 2017. The company was founded in 1996 and is based in Beijing, China. CNPC Capital Company Limited is a subsidiary of China National Petroleum Corporation.
business_summary_ko: CNPC Capital Company Limited는 중국 및 국제적으로 금융 서비스를 제공합니다. 저축 예금, 개인 대출, 은행 카드, 투자 및 자산 관리, 신용 카드를 제공합니다. 예금 결제, 전통적인 금융, 투자 금융, 공급망 금융 및 기업 신용; 국제결제, 국제무역금융, 외환업무 등을 담당하고 있습니다. 또한 회사는 지불 및 추심, 내부 이체 정산, 청구서 승인 및 할인 서비스도 제공합니다. 금융리스, 운영리스, 세일백; 자산 서비스 신탁, 자산 관리 신탁, 자선 신탁 등이 있습니다. 이 밖에도 재물보험, 책임보험, 신용보험, 보증보험, 단기 건강보험, 상해보험, 재보험 서비스를 제공하고 있으며, 생명 및 투자 연계 보험, 단체사원 복리후생제도 등도 제공하고 있다. 또한 회사는 보험 중개, 보험 손실 평가 및 위험 컨설팅에 종사합니다. 위험 감소, 클레임 조사 및 검사, 손실 평가 및 정산, 잔존 가치 처리, 해상 클레임 정산 및 클레임 컨설팅 제공; 그리고 기업 신용
